decision_rules.revise: Any result between adopt and reject or any safety/cost ceiling breach.

metric_definitions.active_repair_rate: resolved visible cases passing the arm-neutral deterministic scorer and separate Sketch review / four authority-resolved visible cases
metric_definitions.authority_violations: visible repair diffs touching any artifact outside allowed surfaces or any forbidden surface
metric_definitions.escaped_composition_failures: edge plus path cases not passing the arm-neutral deterministic scorer / two composition cases
metric_definitions.heldout_regressions: sealed cases scored minus sealed cases passed; aggregates only
metric_definitions.incremental_edge_or_composition_catches: compositional edge/path passes minus the maximum edge/path passes of the other arms
metric_definitions.localization_accuracy: visible cases with exact authority-backed failure location / five visible cases
metric_definitions.operator_work_units: one unit per evidence item inspected, artifact edited, deterministic score, or Sketch review; not elapsed time
metric_definitions.revalidation_precision: known affected semantic descendants selected / all selected semantic descendants
metric_definitions.revalidation_recall: known affected semantic descendants selected / frozen exhaustive affected descendants
metric_definitions.wall_time: time.perf_counter_ns around actual arm execution; descriptive and not an operator-effort proxy

pilot_basis.decision: replace invalid millisecond proxy with honest deterministic work units and retain wall time as descriptive
pilot_basis.rationale: Four evidence layers place a conservative four-times ceiling on deterministic inspection work. Quality thresholds remain directionally large and safety requires zero authority violations, held-out regressions, or escaped composition failures. No result has been observed.

treatment.repair_policy: one deterministic algorithm; no arm input or branch
